name: @kairotic/patterns
description: Kairotic patterns after SuperCollider's (and Overtone's): pbind (a pattern as EDN data with #pat/ generators), pattern (a pattern as Clojure code with seeded randomness), player (by its own clock, step by step, or at a position in beats) and render (a stretch of a pattern drawn into a freqt, through time maps)
author: bonuoq
